## Example files

Build your own file and use the examples to check individual operations. Supplied groups may be reused with credit. The point-cloud file is a supplementary example. Select the lesson object and press Home over the node editor to see the whole graph. Read the Frames in order. Change the inputs on the nodes or, where there are controls, in the GeometryNodes modifier.

Prepared in **Blender 5.2.1 LTS**. Older Blender versions may not have the volume nodes used in later classes.

**[Volumetric Data and Fields — point clouds]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/06-point-clouds-volumes/Point-Clouds-and-Volumes.blend)** — download .blend

1. Import points
2. Analyze points
3. Points to volume

Keep the data folder together: the file reads teaching-courtyard.ply from the same folder. It is a made-up point cloud for teaching, not a site survey.

Supporting files: [Teaching point cloud]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/06-point-clouds-volumes/teaching-courtyard.ply), [Dataset source and units]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/06-point-clouds-volumes/teaching-courtyard.json).

**[Volumetric Data and Fields — signed distance and Booleans]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/07-advanced-volumes/Advanced-Volumes-Session-1.blend)** — download .blend

1. Mesh to SDF
2. Signed distance
3. SDF Boolean

**[Volumetric Data and Fields — noise and surface extraction]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/07-advanced-volumes/Advanced-Volumes-Session-2.blend)** — download .blend

## Learn more

- [Morphogenesis resources (Jason Webb)](https://github.com/jasonwebb/morphogenesis-resources) — one section per strategy, with pictures, papers and code
- [The Nature of Code: Randomness and noise](https://natureofcode.com/random/) — random values, seeds and Perlin noise
- [The Nature of Code: Cellular Automata](https://natureofcode.com/cellular-automata/) — Wolfram rules and the Game of Life
- [The Nature of Code: Autonomous Agents](https://natureofcode.com/autonomous-agents/) — steering and flocking
- [The Nature of Code: Physics Libraries](https://natureofcode.com/physics-libraries/) — springs and forces that settle
- [The Nature of Code: Evolutionary Computing](https://natureofcode.com/genetic-algorithms/) — select and breed, as in the design space
- [Parametric Camp](https://www.youtube.com/@ParametricCamp) — computational design videos for the Grasshopper route
